items.question: What is Crestmoor Estates' role in the warehouse lease?
items.answer:
Crestmoor Estates Ltd is the Landlord under the lease. The lease is between Crestmoor Estates Ltd (the "Landlord") and Voss-Lindqvist Logistics Ltd (the "Tenant") [1].

The lease covers Unit 7, Harbour Road Trading Estate, Southampton SO14 3XY, which is referred to as the "Premises" [3].

The Tenant is required to pay a rent deposit of GBP 21,000, which is to be held by the Landlord until the end of the Term [4].

The Tenant must use the Premises only for storage and distribution within Use Class B8 [5].

The Landlord is responsible for keeping the structure and roof of the Premises in repair [6].
